component.name: Open Speech Studio
component.summary: Dictate, record meetings and transcribe audio locally with Whisper

description.p: This is a community package of Open Speech Studio, maintained independently and unaffiliated with the OpenAEC Foundation. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

Open Speech Studio turns speech into text on your own computer with Whisper. Hold a hotkey and dictate, and the text is typed where your cursor is; record a meeting and watch the transcript grow; or transcribe WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG and M4A files. It recognises 99 languages. The Whisper "small" model ships with the app, so it works offline with no account; seven other models, from tiny to large-v3, can be downloaded in the app.

Typing into other apps and the global hotkeys go through X11: on a Wayland desktop they work with apps running under XWayland. Meetings record the microphone; capturing what the computer plays is available on Windows only. Transcription runs on the CPU. Closing the window keeps the app running in the tray; quit it from the tray menu.

Sandbox: display, X11 for hotkeys and typing, GPU for drawing, the microphone, network for model downloads and the optional OpenAEC sign-in, the tray icon and notifications. Files are opened and saved through the file chooser. Updates come through FlatPark.
The optional OpenAEC account sign-in (for upstream's remote transcription server) keeps its tokens in the system keyring, which is not granted by default:

ul.li: Allow the keyring: flatpak override --user --talk-name=org.freedesktop.secrets org.openaec.OpenSpeechStudio
